blocks.title: Welcome to Constructions
blocks.body: Before we dive in, let's look at a real-life example of this concept.
blocks.body_hi: इससे पहले कि हम शुरू करें, आइए इस अवधारणा का एक वास्तविक जीवन उदाहरण देखें।

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.body: To divide a line segment in the ratio 3:5, how many total equal arcs must be marked on the auxiliary ray?
blocks.body_hi: To divide a line segment in the ratio 3:5, how many total equal arcs must be marked on the auxiliary ray?

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.body: A triangle is constructed similar to a given triangle with scale factor 3/4. If the given triangle's side is 12 cm, find the new triangle's corresponding side.
blocks.body_hi: A triangle is constructed similar to a given triangle with scale factor 3/4. If the given triangle's side is 12 cm, find the new triangle's corresponding side.

blocks.title: Example 3
blocks.body: A triangle with side 8 cm is enlarged with scale factor 5/3. Find the new side length.
blocks.body_hi: A triangle with side 8 cm is enlarged with scale factor 5/3. Find the new side length.

blocks.title: Example 4
blocks.body: To divide a segment in the ratio 2:7, how many total equal arcs are marked?

blocks.title: Example 5
blocks.body: Tangents are constructed from a point 15 cm from the centre of a circle of radius 9 cm. Find the tangent length.
